reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id IN (15, 16, 18)
  AND unit_cost_eur < 100
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur < 100
  AND category_id IN (18, 16, 15)

SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (category_id = 15 OR category_id = 16 OR category_id = 18)
  AND unit_cost_eur < 100

other_way.sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (category_id = 15 OR category_id = 16 OR category_id = 18)
  AND unit_cost_eur < 100
other_way.tradeoff: An OR chain returns the same rows, but repeats the column for every value, while IN keeps the list short.
